title: The g58 round of the seven questions holds on JA Essence Joomla/WordPress and Tracy EmDash, and ships with its releases: Claude Cowork for Joomla 0.24.11, Tracy Business EmDash 1.7.7, Tracy SaaS EmDash 1.4.4 pinned, contract ja-essence/wp7/1.0.12 for theme 1.0.12
steps: S1: node --test the round's tests: apps/tracy-web/test/{joomla-site-words,joomla-article-titles,joomla-button-labels,joomla-kit-pages,brief-joomla,brief-wordpress,brief-wp-posts,brief-wp-leaves,brief-emdash}.test.mjs; packages/cms/tracy-wordpress-theme/test/essence.test.mjs; the EmDash Business (personalize-kit-pictures, personalize-trim, page-gate, empty-claims), SaaS and Base personalize-facts tests.
S2: read both quickstarts.json: every Joomla pin's Claude Cowork version, and the tracy-business/emdash and tracy-saas/emdash entries.
S3: read packages/cms/tracy-wordpress-quickstart/contracts/ja-essence/wp7/1.0.12/{manifest,presentation-lock}.json and the quickstart/ja-essence/wp7 1.0.12 row of template-profiles.json.
expect: S1: every test passes, none skipped or cancelled.
S2: every Joomla pin on Claude Cowork 0.24.11; tracy-business/emdash 1.7.7 and tracy-saas/emdash 1.4.4, source and state files named for that version with a GitHub asset id.
S3: contract id ja-essence/wp7/1.0.12, quickstart version 1.0.12, the lock pins inc/words.php and style.css of theme 1.0.12; the profile row says logos pair, brandReady.
fence: The brief engines' language and template-word rules of the g58 round, and the releases this repository pins for them.
